title: Deterministic Implementation of Mean-Preserving Contractions
abstract: arXiv:2610.41284v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study whether randomization is needed to generate a prescribed distribution of posterior means for a one-dimensional state. Drawing on backward Monge martingale transport, we show that every mean-preserving contraction of an atomless prior with finite first moment admits a deterministic implementation. Consequently, restricting attention to deterministic signals leaves the designer's value unchanged whenever objectives and constraints depend only on the posterior-mean distribution. We decompose implementation into independent problems on non-separating intervals and describe a constructive procedure based on barcode transport. We also characterize when lower or upper contour sets can take a nested-interval form, and provide applications to monopolistic pricing with buyer-optimal learning and robust persuasion with ambiguous receiver preferences.

translated_title: 保均值收缩的确定性实现
translated_abstract: 我们研究对于一维状态，生成给定的后验均值分布是否需要随机化。借助反向Monge鞅传输理论，我们证明了每一个具有有限一阶矩的无原子先验的保均值收缩都存在确定性实现。因此，只要设计者的目标函数和约束条件仅依赖于后验均值分布，将注意力限制在确定性信号上不会改变设计者所能获得的价值。我们将实现问题分解为在各不分隔区间上的独立子问题，并描述了基于条码传输的构造性求解步骤。我们还刻画了下等高集或上等高集何时可以呈现嵌套区间的形式，并给出了在买方最优学习下的垄断定价以及接收者偏好模糊情形下的稳健劝说问题中的应用。
tldr: 本文证明一维状态下任意保均值的后验均值分布收缩均可通过确定性信号实现，因此当信息设计目标仅依赖后验均值分布时无需使用随机信号。
en_tdlr: Using backward Monge martingale transport, the paper shows that every mean-preserving contraction of a posterior-mean distribution admits a deterministic implementation, implying random signals are unnecessary in information design whenever objectives depend only on the posterior-mean distribution.
